info.name: Getting a list of recipients with filtering

params.name: page
params.description: The page number to request (defaults to 1)

params.name: per
params.description: The number of results to load per page (defaults to 10)

params.name: created_at_from
params.description:
Start date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`

params.name: created_at_to
params.description:
End date to filter recipients by created_at range
Allows filtering results by the specified `created_at` timeframe.

Example: `/v1/recipients?created_at_from=2018-06-06&created_at_to=2018-06-08`

params.name: amount_from
params.description:
Minimum amount to filter recipients by amount range.

Allows filtering results by the specified `amount` range. When using this filter, the `currency` should also be specified.

Example: `/v1/recipients?currency=NGN&amount_from=83.76672339&amount_to=83.76672339`

params.name: amount_to
params.description:
Max amount to filter recipients by amount range.

Allows filtering results by the specified `amount` range. When using this filter, the `currency` should also be specified.

Example: `/v1/recipients?currency=NGN&amount_from=83.76672339&amount_to=83.76672339`

params.name: state
params.description:
Allows filtering results by `state` of recipient. See [API Documentation - Recipient state](https://docs.transferzero.com/docs/transaction-flow/#state) for possible states.

Example: `/v1/recipients?state[]=error&state[]=initial`

params.name: currency
params.description:
Allows filtering results by `input_currency`.

Additionally required when filtering by an amount range
Example: `/v1/recipients?currency[]=KES&currency[]=NGN`

params.name: Recipient ID
params.description:
ID of recipient to update.

Example: `/v1/recipients/9d4d7b73-a94c-4979-ab57-09074fd55d33`

items.docs:
Updates the recipient specified in the URL path.

Please note that only recipients where the `editable` field is true can be modified. Once the recipient is modified any subsequent payout tries will be sent to the updated details.

params.name: Recipient ID
params.description:
ID of recipient to cancel.

Example: `/v1/recipients/9d4d7b73-a94c-4979-ab57-09074fd55d33`

items.docs:
Cancels the payment to the recipient specified in the URL path.

Please note recipients where the `may_cancel` attribute is true will be cancelled immediately. If the `may_cancel` attribute is false you can still try to cancel the recipient, however it will only gets cancelled if we will receive a confirmation from our partner that the payment has failed

info.name: Returns list of proof of payments

params.name: Recipient ID
params.description:
ID of the recipient for whom the proof of payments will be returned.

Example: `/v1/recipients/9d4d7b73-a94c-4979-ab57-09074fd55d33/proof_of_payments`

items.docs: Returns a list of uploaded proof of payment files for a transaction recipient
